coordinator_decision: Prepare independent tied-convolution Q0 and exact full-shape admission first; no concurrent remote computation or E2 performance claim. Structural choices below precede any E2 arrays/results and do not depend on E1 outcomes.
operators: Two 2D cross-correlations, flatten, dense, dense. No bias, pooling, dilation beyond 1, groups beyond 1, or kernel flipping. A canonical LIF cell follows every projection, including the last dense readout.
flatten: Channel-major CHW, index=(channel*height+y)*width+x; never HWC. Dense parameters retain source-major [input,output] ordering.
convolution_parameter_index: OIHW, id=(((out_channel*in_channels+in_channel)*kernel_height+kernel_y)*kernel_width+kernel_x); exactly one independent parameter and Adam moment slot per kernel coefficient shared at every spatial use.
projection: Target-major lexicographic (out_channel,out_y,out_x,in_channel,kernel_y,kernel_x). Input coordinate=(out_y*stride+kernel_y-padding,out_x*stride+kernel_x-padding); omit out-of-range input edges, equivalent to zero padding. Source CHW flatten, target CHW flatten, parameter index OIHW. No untied expansion of weights.
native_helper_reference: snapshot/brian2-rust/python/brian2_rust/training_graph.py:conv2d_training_projection; fixture topology is independently constructed from this frozen indexing equation, then optionally checked against the source helper without importing forward/gradient math.

inputs.format: B,T,flattened CHW; count integers in JSON, FP64 in compute
inputs.rng: NumPy default_rng(seed), PCG64. Draw full input array, then independent banks in projection order; all engines consume identical persisted arrays rather than matching seeds alone.

weights: Independent Normal(0,sqrt(2/fan_in)); conv fan_in=in_channels*kernel_height*kernel_width, regardless of image flatten size or edge padding; dense fan_in=source_count. Draw convolution arrays in OIHW C-order and dense arrays in [input,output] C-order, flatten each bank once.
initial: Zero by default; Q0 boundary variant fills the whole Bxsum(neuron_sizes) state by repeating [1/.95,1/.95-1e-7,1/.95+1e-7,-.5,.2,0] with a sample-dependent cyclic offset.
dynamics: beta=.95, theta=1, strict >, stopped reset spike VJP, slope-5 fast sigmoid surrogate. All populations threshold before same-tick projection additions; spikes affect the next threshold. Zero recurrent projections and no delays.
loss: Cross entropy of logits=5*mean_over_time(last_layer_spikes), mean over the full batch
optimizer: Native Adam, FP64 parameters/moments, lr=.001, betas=.9/.999, eps=1e-8, eps_root=0; exactly one update per full global batch. Native SGD one-step cross-check in Q0.
strong_operator_baseline: Torch uses torch.nn.functional.conv2d and JAX uses lax.conv_general_dilated with NCHW/OIHW/NCHW dimension numbers. Shared kernel autograd accumulation is native to conv; scatter is only the independent graph reference. Legal acyclic layerwise retiming batches the B*T convolutions, with one-tick causal delay and beta applied to the previous current; full state/spike/VJP Q0 must pass.
qualification: Independent NumPy graph forward/VJP oracle; all state/spike/logit/loss arrays, initial VJP and every shared parameter gradient, local surrogate VJP, one SGD and three Adam steps. Atlas full-state Q0 uses bounded prefix replay; full-size Atlas may expose only final membrane and must disclose that scope.
admission: Exact canonical request bytes and graph tape estimate with every shared parameter counted once and every logical edge counted for topology. Initial admission is not training qualification and cannot predict later Adam-state request sizes without real updates.

execution.concurrency: Do not start while any E1 or R performance/qualification compute phase is active; current delivery is code and static review only.

failure_accounting: Track native/adapter execution, oracle and artifact-save phases separately. Timeout in diagnostics/serialization is not an engine performance or capacity failure; a 64 GiB supervisor guard is resource_limit, not physical OOM; Atlas request rejection is budget_rejected.
